neighbours.label: mobile services that use where a person is (check-in, location-based, geolocation, points of interest, mobility data)
fire: Shoppers check-in at the mall on Foursquare to collect discounts.
The carrier launched location-based advertising for its smartphone users.
Tap the map to see each point of interest around your position.
Researchers tracked smartphone mobility traces to study commuting across the city.
The startup built a geolocation app that tells you which friends are nearby.
Drivers share their GPS location with the app to find a ride.
Her phone sends a location update whenever she arrives at the office.
Wireless carriers sell location data on where their customers travel.
quiet: Shoppers sign up at the mall on Facebook to collect discounts.
The carrier launched video streaming for its smartphone users.
Tap the screen to see each photo of the wedding on your phone.
Researchers tracked smartphone battery life to study charging across the year.
The startup built a messaging app that tells you which friends are online.
Drivers share their song lists with the app to find a tune.
Her phone sends a sound alert whenever she gets a text message.
Wireless carriers sell data plans on which their customers rely.
